notes.title: Cinderia Demo Update – Version V0.3.4
notes.content:
[p]【About the New Product Festival Demo】[/p]
[list]
[][p]This demo will close this Sunday—thank you all for your support.[/p][/]
[][p]This update will be the last minor patch for the demo version.[/p][/]
[][p]Join our QQ group 1026715524 for news about the next test.[/p][/]
[][p]Anyone interested in ongoing testing can join the group to learn about long-term test opportunities.[/p][/]
[/list]

[p]【Updates】[/p]
[list]
[][p]Reworked all enemies’ attack-telegraph logic[/p][/]
[][p]Optimized Blue’s parry detection—raising your shield when the enemy flashes white now always triggers a perfect parry[/p][/]
[][p]Reworked Yellow’s reload—she can now attack, move, and dash during the reload state[/p][/]
[][p]Added a red guiding line feature for navigation[/p][/]
[/list]

[p]【Bug Fixes】[/p]
[list]
[][p]Fixed lava damage not being calculated correctly[/p][/]
[][p]Fixed abnormal sizing of the buff-bar icon frame[/p][/]
[][p]Fixed display issues with fishing prompts in controller mode[/p][/]
[][p]Adjusted the tooltip position in the item slot for the English version[/p][/]
[][p]Red’s shadow clone now attacks the nearest enemy to itself[/p][/]
[][p]Fixed some combo-altering skills not consuming energy correctly[/p][/]
[][p]Fixed Yellow’s timed-bomb VFX not matching the actual detonation timing[/p][/]
[][p]Fixed Blue’s flag shrinking to an extremely small size[/p][/]
[][p]Plus various other minor fixes[/p][/]
[/list]

notes.title: 《Cinderia》Demo Version Update V0.3.3B
notes.content:
[h3]【Optimization!】[/h3][p]This update focuses on a variety of mysterious performance optimizations related to spine animations and game scenes.
If you notice any animations tearing or suddenly disappearing in-game, don’t panic... just report the bug![/p][hr][/hr][h3]【Controller Support】[/h3][p]Controller input has been slightly reworked. The new setup is now partially implemented but still under adjustment.[/p][p]We’re currently experimenting with controller interactions.
The first version will likely use [i]combo buttons[/i] for active skills.
Later, we’ll add a second default layout using [i]single buttons[/i], as well as [i]custom remapping[/i] (ETA: maybe in a month?).[/p][hr][/hr][h3]【Other Changes】[/h3][list][*][p]Slight adjustment to character dashes:
→ [b]Little Blue[/b]'s dash count increased from 1 → 2[/p][/*][*][p]Some item and skill values have been tweaked.[/p][/*][/list][p]As the game is still in early development, balance changes are happening frequently and may not always be documented in detail. More thorough patch notes will be provided in future updates.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]【Bug Fixes】[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where re-picking the Giant Beanstalk would repeatedly trigger its effects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect text descriptions for some items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where stealth did not prevent some enemy tracking skills[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed main menu UI sound effects stacking incorrectly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing the character to flip mirror-style while fishing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed camera reset issues under certain conditions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where thrown knives would incorrectly appear as shurikens when a throwing talent was active[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Little Blue would lose HP when activating Frost Sweep while having "All-Out Charge" and "Frost Sweep" at the same time[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed VFX issues for Little Blue’s [i]Frost Flurry[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Little Red’s “Desolation” didn’t actually increase shadow damage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Light Torch’s activation timing being inconsistent with its description[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect text description for the Giant’s Axe[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed HP bonus display bug for Giant Beanstalk[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an exploit where Soulmoth Lantern could heal infinitely[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect effect trajectories for Soulmoth Lantern[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Soulmoth Lantern effects would wrongly fly to summoned units[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Soulmoth Lantern triggering when summons disappeared[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Little Yellow’s “Heavy Strike” also inflicted Cripple[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Mermaid’s Tear effects not being removed with Curse Purge[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the first use of the grappling hook would launch backward[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where enemy mobs didn’t die with the boss[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed infinite shop refresh issue when using controller[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an invisible wall in Chapter 3 that could only be crossed from below[/p][/*][*][p]...and other minor issues[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Since it’s translated by GPT, feel free to ask if anything seems unclear or ambiguous...[/p]
